zh: 凌雲霄一個人去了太虛峰。燕飛霜，被留在了蓮池邊。
他一個人去，萬一夜無極真的在那裡……
他不讓妳去，是因為妳身上帶著劍譜。夜無極要的，從來不只是他。
我知道。我只是……不習慣，被人保護。
那就慢慢習慣。在這個江湖裡，肯保護妳的人，比要殺妳的人，少得多。
太虛峰，道門玄宗所在。雲海之上，只有風聲和酒香。
師弟，你又喝。三教大會上，你喝得還不夠嗎？
師兄，大會上那幾杯，是陪殷九霄喝的。這幾杯，才是陪自己喝的。
哼。慧明那孩子死得蹊蹺，你倒是一點都不放在心上。
放在心上，所以才要喝。師兄，你可知道，大會前一夜，慧明來找過我？
他說，想聽聽貧道對劍譜的看法。然後，他陪貧道，喝了三杯。
還有更怪的。他舉杯，用的是左手。
慧明那孩子，從小在萬佛峰長大，貧道看著他抄經。他是右手寫字的。
貧道什麼都沒說。貧道只是，喝多了。
白鶴道長！晚輩冒昧前來，是有要事相告。
凌少俠？什麼事，比喝酒還急？
夜無極沒有死。有人在太虛峰下，看見了血蓮的旗。
胡說！那魔頭墜入雲海，屍骨無存，怎麼可能——
活著？不。本尊是死過一次，又從幽冥爬回來的人。
凌雲霄，這一次，本尊不殺你。本尊要你看著。
魔頭！太虛峰上，豈容你放肆！
好……好一個魔頭。貧道今天，不喝了。
道門的劍陣，也不過如此。
凌雲霄，你的劍，還是這麼乾淨。乾淨得，讓本尊想吐。
你的掌，比三個月前，多了一股死氣。
那是帝君給本尊的禮物。你也收下吧！
別急著死。本尊說過，要你看著。
殷九霄在此，魔頭，休得猖狂！
想必是忌憚儒門的威名。道長，傷得可重？
殷兄來得正好。又剛好……晚了一步。
九霄一接到消息，就連夜趕來了。若是能早一刻……
太……太虛令……師弟，太虛令不見了！
什麼？封印劍譜的太虛令？
一定是那魔頭趁亂搶走的。九霄立刻派人去追！
沒有人看見，殷九霄的袖中，多了一樣東西。
別說話，少俠。你這條命，現在比劍譜要緊。
凌少俠中的是幽冥之掌。天下能救他的，只有萬佛峰上那個老和尚。
無涯佛者閉關二十年……他肯出關嗎？
殷九霄來了。他是帝君的棋子，本尊不能，壞了帝君的棋局。
很好。讓凌雲霄活著，讓他們去萬佛峰。
那個老和尚出關的那一天，就是三教，自己拆散自己的那一天。
鏡王，會替本帝，戴上佛者的臉。
洛先生！大事不好！太虛峰被血洗了，凌少俠中了夜無極一掌！
還活著！白鶴道長說，只有萬佛峰的無涯佛者救得了他。
夜無極在殷九霄面前，就這樣走了？
是啊，大家都說，殷閣主好威風。
一個魔頭，怕的不是威風。他怕的，是壞了別人的事。
我們一起去。萬佛峰上，還有一個二十年沒見過的老朋友。
錢不二，替我送個消息給魏無憂：三天之後，萬佛峰見。
魏大俠，洛先生有話帶給你：三天之後，萬佛峰見。
好好好，送你的！凌少俠在太虛峰中了夜無極一掌，要上萬佛峰找佛者救命。
凌雲霄輸給了夜無極？……哼，他輸了，我還怎麼贏他？
告訴洛無塵，我會去。不是為了他，是為了我的刀。
儒門的印，在這裡。道門的太虛令，也在這裡。
三道封印，已經有兩道，在九霄的手中了。
恭喜閣主。最後那一道，佛門的，就交給本王吧。
無涯那個老和尚，可不是太虛峰那兩個酒鬼。
所以，不能搶。要讓他自己，親手交出來。
讓整個江湖，都相信他是兇手。一個兇手，還有什麼資格，守著佛門的封印？
一個……太虛峰上，剛剛受了傷的老人。死在佛者的掌下，三教就再也沒有人，會相信那個老和尚了。
……哈哈。鏡王，你這張臉，真是越看越可怕。
閣主過獎。本王的臉，還沒有閣主的心，一半可怕。
魔影重臨，凌雲霄命懸一線；萬佛峰上的鐘聲，二十年後，將再一次響起。
en: Ling Yunxiao went to Void Peak alone. Yan Feishuang was left behind by the lotus pond.
Miss Yan’s blades are impatient today.
He went alone. If Ye Wuji really is there...
He would not take you because you carry the manual. Ye Wuji never wanted only him.
I know. I am only... not used to being protected.
Then grow used to it, slowly. In this world, those who would protect you are far fewer than those who would kill you.
Void Peak, home of the Taoist Void School. Above the sea of clouds there is only the wind, and the smell of wine.
Little brother, drinking again? Didn’t you drink enough at the council?
Elder brother, those cups at the council were for Yin Jiuxiao. These are for me.
Hmph. That boy Huiming died strangely, and you don’t seem to care in the least.
I care — that’s why I drink. Elder brother, did you know Huiming came to see me the night before the council?
What did he want with you?
He said he wished to hear my view of the manual. And then he kept me company — for three cups.
There’s something stranger. He lifted his cup with his left hand.
I watched that boy copy sutras on the Peak since he was small. He wrote with his right hand.
I mean nothing at all. I have only had too much to drink.
Master Baihe! Forgive my coming unannounced — I bring urgent news.
Young Master Ling? What could be more urgent than wine?
Ye Wuji is not dead. Someone saw the Blood Lotus banner below Void Peak.
Nonsense! The demon fell into the sea of clouds and left no bones — how could he —
The blood lotus opens again, and ten thousand bones run dry;
back from the Nine Netherworlds, I am the slaughter.
Ye Wuji... so you are alive.
Alive? No. I am a man who died once, and crawled back up out of the Netherworld.
Ling Yunxiao. This time I will not kill you. This time I want you to watch.
Demon! On Void Peak you will not do as you please!
Good... a fine demon. Today I am done with wine.
So that is the Taoists’ famous formation. It is nothing.
Ling Yunxiao, your sword is as clean as ever. So clean it turns my stomach.
Your palm carries something it did not three months ago — the breath of the dead.
A gift from my Emperor. You may have it too!
Don’t hurry to die. I told you — I want you to watch.
Yin Jiuxiao is here. Demon — no more of this!
...Ha. Ha ha ha! Very well. Enough for today.
...The demon saw Brother Yin, and simply left?
No doubt he fears the name of the Confucians. Master — are you badly hurt?
Brother Yin came just in time. And just... a moment too late.
I came through the night the moment I heard. If only I had been a little sooner...
The... the Void token... little brother, the Void token is gone!
What? The Void token — the one meant to seal the manual?
The demon must have snatched it in the confusion. I shall send men after him at once!
No one saw that something new had found its way into Yin Jiuxiao’s sleeve.
Don’t speak, young master. Right now your life matters more than any manual.
Young Master Ling took a palm of the Netherworld. Under heaven, only the old monk on the Peak can save him.
The Buddha Wuya has been in seclusion twenty years... will he come out?
To save a life, he will.
Why did you not kill Ling Yunxiao?
Yin Jiuxiao came. He is my Emperor’s piece; I could not spoil my Emperor’s game.
Good. Let Ling Yunxiao live. Let them go to the Peak.
The day that old monk comes out of seclusion will be the day the Three Teachings tear themselves apart.
The Mirror King will put on the Buddha’s face — for me.
Master Luo! Terrible news! Void Peak was attacked — Master Ling took a palm from Ye Wuji!
Still alive! Master Baihe says only the Buddha Wuya can save him.
And Ye Wuji simply left, the moment Yin Jiuxiao appeared?
Yes! Everyone says how imposing the Pavilion Master was.
A demon does not fear an imposing man. What he fears is spoiling someone else’s plans.
Master Luo, I am going to the Peak.
We go together. On the Peak there is an old friend I have not seen in twenty years.
Qian Bu’er, take a message to Wei Wuyou for me: three days from now, at the Peak.
This message... do I get paid for it?
You may collect from him yourself.
Master Wei, a word from Master Luo: three days from now, at the Peak.
What is he up to now?
All right, all right, it’s free! Master Ling took a palm from Ye Wuji at Void Peak and has to go to the Peak to be saved by the Buddha.
Ling Yunxiao lost to Ye Wuji? ...Hmph. If he’s beaten, how am I supposed to beat him?
Tell Luo Wuchen I’ll come. Not for him — for my blade.
And that message... do I charge for it?
The Confucian seal — here. The Taoists’ Void token — here as well.
Of the three seals, two now lie in my hand.
Congratulations, Pavilion Master. The last one, the Buddhists’, leave to this king.
That old monk Wuya is no pair of drunkards from Void Peak.
Which is why it must not be taken. He must be made to hand it over with his own hands.
And how do you propose that?
Make the whole world believe he is a murderer. What right has a murderer to keep the Buddhist seal?
An old man... freshly wounded, on Void Peak. Let him die beneath the Buddha’s palm, and no one in the Three Teachings will ever trust that old monk again.
...Ha ha. Mirror King, the longer I look at that face, the more it frightens me.
The Pavilion Master flatters me. This king’s face is not half as frightening as the Pavilion Master’s heart.
The demon’s shadow is back, and Ling Yunxiao’s life hangs by a thread; on the Peak, for the first time in twenty years, the bell is about to ring.
